verdict.rationale: The evidence shows predictive scoring for churn and conversion (docs-15) and an assistant that suggests audience or journey logic (docs-16/22). These are adjacent capabilities, not autonomous agents that choose message, timing and channel per customer within user-set guardrails. The 'lift match rates' claim (docs-12) is about identity match rates, not measured decisioning lift, so nothing documents the story's capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI decisioning agents pick messages, timing, and channels per customer autonomously within guardrails I set, with measurable lift
